prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universal “best” — the right roofing company for you depends on your needs (residential vs commercial), budget, roof type, warranty priorities, and whether you’re filing an insurance claim. I can, however, help you pick the best contractor for your situation.

Quick checklist to find a top Dallas roof replacement contractor
- Get at least 3 written estimates with line-item pricing (labor, materials, disposal, permits).  
- Verify insurance: ask for current general liability and workers’ comp certificates and call the carrier to confirm.  
- Confirm local registration/permits and that they pull permits and follow Dallas building code.  
- Ask about warranties: manufacturer (shingles) and workmanship (company). Get details in writing.  
- Check reviews: Google, Yelp, Angi, BBB, and recent photos of completed jobs. Look for repeat complaints.  
- Ask for references and drive by recent jobs if possible.  
- Avoid “storm-chaser” sales pressure; get time to review contracts and compare estimates.  
- Clarify cleanup and disposal responsibilities and whether they will handle insurance adjuster meetings if applicable.  
- Require a written contract with payment schedule, start/end dates, materials/specs, and lien release language.

If you want, I can:
- Research and give a short list (3–5) of highly rated roofers that service your Dallas ZIP code, with pros/cons and recent reviews.  
- Or recommend companies that specialize in insurance claims, or in specific roof types (asphalt shingles, metal, tile).

Tell me your ZIP code, whether it’s residential or commercial, and if you’re filing an insurance claim — I’ll assemble a tailored shortlist.
